main_measure.name: mean case gain (forecast/10 x excess 72-bar forward return), non-overlapping grid, forecast < 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting difference < 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: excess 72-bar return, forecast below median minus above median (Welch t)

decided_by: The main t is between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Grid bars are at positions 0, 72, 144, ... of each window and need an in-window forward return; each coin's mean 72-bar return is taken over all its grid bars in all windows; bars equal to the median forecast are left out of both groups of the supporting check; the plan's 'fewer than 300 grid bars' minimum is treated as 'not observable'.
